raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Pending on vllm-xpu-kernels PR [#616](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/616). This PR uses refined `multimodal_rotary_embedding` xpu kernel to replace triton kernel path, getting ~13% throughput improvement. It also unifies the XPU path with the CUDA implementation and avoids maintaining divergent dispatch behavior. 

## Claims
Perf collection cmds:
```
IMAGE_SIZE=512 NUM_WARMUP=2  python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct --enforce-eager --port 8055 --host 0.0.0.0 --trust-remote-code --gpu-memory-util=0.92 --no-enable-prefix-caching --max-num-batched-tokens=8192  --max-model-len=6000  --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image": 1}' --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 --max-num-seqs 12     -tp=4
vllm bench serve  --model Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct --ready-check-timeout-sec 1 --temperature=0  --num-warmups 15  --random-input-len=4096 --random-output-len=1024 --dataset-name random-mm --endpoint /v1/chat/completions  --ignore-eos --port=8055 --host 0.0.0.0 --num-prompts 45 --request-rate inf --backend openai-chat  --trust-remote-code --max-concurrency 15  --random-mm-base-items-per-request 1 --random-mm-limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image": 1, "video": 0}' --random-mm-bucket-config '{(512, 512, 1): 1.0}' --seed 42
```

---------------Time to First Token----------------
